questions.question: What does the Z gate do to |0⟩?
questions.explanation: Z|0⟩ = |0⟩. The Z gate only affects the |1⟩ component by multiplying it by -1.

questions.question: What is Z|+⟩?
questions.explanation: Z|+⟩ = Z(|0⟩+|1⟩)/√2 = (|0⟩−|1⟩)/√2 = |−⟩. The Z gate flips the relative phase.

questions.question: Which axis does the Z gate rotate around on the Bloch sphere?
questions.explanation: The Z gate performs a π rotation around the Z-axis. That's why |0⟩ and |1⟩ (on the Z-axis) are eigenstates.
